role: Fitness tab pre-flight surface: sport chips + strap status pill, Start button that resolves HR source and hands the plan to FitnessTabView.startWorkout, route disclosure (bound route summary or saved-route/GPX/trail picker), and coaching disclosure (intervals, target zone, smart cues). Also defines Sport.themeColor.
types: WorkoutPreflightView: struct View — plan + start surface reading WorkoutPlanModel from environment
SportChip: private struct View — selectable sport capsule
StrapStatusPill: private struct View — Polar connection pill opening the sensor sheet
BoundRouteSummary: private struct View — map preview + stats for the picked route
RoutePicker: private struct View — saved-route carousel, Find-a-trail sheet, GPX file importer
SavedRouteCarouselCard: private struct View — saved route card
IntervalsRow / TargetZoneRow / ThresholdsRow: private struct View — coaching option rows
Sport: extension — themeColor for the Start button
